text:
[LREG.8.5] Engine semantics for character classes follow RE2's
defaults. `\w` matches `[A-Za-z0-9_]` (ASCII), not Unicode
word characters. A `u` flag for Unicode-aware classes is
reserved per [LREG.5.4]; until it lands, authors needing
Unicode word-class semantics enumerate explicitly via
character-class brackets.

---
